notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

sidebar.title: Navigation
sidebar.description: Links to every section of Rowbird.

common.shownOnce: This is shown only once. Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe.

fields.name: Name
fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, memorable password.

setup.title: Set up Rowbird
setup.intro: Create the first administrator account. You can invite the rest of your team afterwards.
setup.tokenHint: The value of ROWBIRD_SETUP_TOKEN configured on the server.

masterKey.title: Back up the master key now
masterKey.body: Rowbird generated the key that encrypts database passwords and channel credentials. Without it, those secrets cannot be recovered, and backups of the database are useless. Copy this file to a safe place outside the server:
masterKey.ack: I have backed up the master key

login.title: Sign in
login.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHelp: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
login.passkeyHelp: Confirm with the passkey on this device, your phone or your security key.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.intro: Your password was set by an administrator. Choose your own password to continue.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

twoFactorSetup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
twoFactorSetup.intro: An administrator requires two-factor authentication for everyone. Set it up to continue.
twoFactorSetup.orApp: or set up an authenticator app

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.help: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when signing in, in addition to the password.
twoFactor.disableHelp: Your account will be protected by the password alone. Confirm with your password.
twoFactor.regenerateHelp: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Confirm with your password.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to add Rowbird to an authenticator app
twoFactor.manualEntry: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually
twoFactor.codesHelp: Use one of these codes to sign in if you lose your authenticator. Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe; they will not be shown again.
twoFactor.savedCodes: I have saved my recovery codes

profile.title: Profile
profile.passwordHelp: Changing the password signs out your other sessions.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.help: Browsers where you are signed in. Sign out any you do not recognize.
sessions.signOutEverywhereHelp: All {count} sessions will be signed out, including this one.

roles.viewerHelp: Can see everything except secrets, view runs and download results.
roles.editorHelp: Viewer, plus writing queries, managing reports and deliveries, and running reports.
roles.adminHelp: Editor, plus connections, channels, users, API keys and settings.

scopes.readHelp: Read everything an admin can read, except secrets.
scopes.writeHelp: Run, plus creating and changing queries, reports and deliveries.
scopes.adminHelp: Full access, including users, API keys and settings.

settings.readOnly: Only admins can change these settings.

general.title: General
general.help: Defaults for new users and reports.
general.timezoneHint: Used for new reports and built-in date parameters.

users.title: Users and roles
users.help: People who can sign in to this Rowbird and what each of them can do.
users.addHelp: The user gets a temporary password that you share with them. They choose their own password at the first sign-in.
users.temporaryPasswordHelp: Share this temporary password with {email} through a private channel. They must change it when they first sign in.
users.changeRoleImpact: {name} ({email}) will become {role} and will be signed out of every session.
users.disableImpact: {name} ({email}) will be signed out everywhere, their API keys will be revoked and they will not be able to sign in.
users.enableImpact: {name} ({email}) will be able to sign in again. Their API keys stay revoked.
users.resetImpact: {name} ({email}) will be signed out everywhere and will get a new temporary password.
users.disable2faImpact: {name} ({email}) will be able to sign in with the password alone. Use this when they lost their authenticator and recovery codes.
users.emptyBody: Users sign in to Rowbird with an email and password. Admins add them here and choose their role.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.help: Keys let scripts and CI pipelines use the Rowbird API. Each key acts with the scopes you give it.
apiKeys.createHelp: Give the key a name that says where it is used, and only the scopes it needs.
apiKeys.createdHelp: Send it in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
apiKeys.expiresHint: Optional. The key stops working at the end of this day.
apiKeys.revokeImpact: Anything using the key {name} will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to call the Rowbird API from scripts, CI pipelines or other tools, for example to trigger a report after a data load.

security.title: Security
security.require2faHelp: When required, users without two-factor authentication must set it up at their next request before doing anything else.
security.require2faImpact: Every user without two-factor authentication, including admins, will have to set it up before continuing.
security.eventsHelp: Sign-ins, account changes and other security-relevant actions, newest first.
security.emptyBody: Security events appear here as people sign in and change accounts, keys and settings.

oidc.title: Single sign-on (OIDC)
oidc.help: Let people sign in with your identity provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Keycloak and others). The provider handles their password and second factor.
oidc.needsBaseURL: Single sign-on needs the public URL of this server (ROWBIRD_BASE_URL) for the address the provider sends people back to.
oidc.enabled: Offer single sign-on on the login page
oidc.redirectHint: Register this address at the provider as the redirect (callback) URI.
oidc.issuerHint: The provider's address; its settings are read from /.well-known/openid-configuration.
oidc.clientSecretHint: Leave empty for a public client, which relies on PKCE alone.
oidc.scopesHint: Separated by spaces. openid is always included.
oidc.buttonLabelHint: For example "Sign in with Acme". Empty shows "Sign in with single sign-on".
oidc.domainsHint: Separated by commas. When set, only verified emails in these domains can sign in with the provider.
oidc.autoProvision: Create an account on the first sign-in
oidc.linking: Someone who already has an account signs into it when the provider has verified the same email; the two are linked from then on.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.help: When a channel or a report starts failing, Rowbird sends an alert through the primary channel, or through the fallback when the primary fails, and a message when it recovers. The notification bell shows the same alerts.
alerts.fallbackHint: Used when the primary fails, or when the alert is about the primary itself.
alerts.noChannels: No channel can carry alerts yet.
alerts.sameDestination: Primary and fallback are the same kind of channel. An outage of that service would stop both; prefer different kinds.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat.help: Rowbird calls this address regularly while it is healthy, so that an external monitor (Uptime Kuma, Healthchecks.io) warns you when it stops.
heartbeat.urlHint: Called with GET. It is stored encrypted and not shown again.

ai.title: AI
ai.help: The assistant writes queries and schedules from a description. It is off until you choose a provider.
ai.privacy: Only the request, the connection's dialect and its schema (without the tables excluded from AI) are sent to the provider. Rows never leave your databases, and proposals are never run until someone applies them.
ai.testOk: The provider accepted the key and the model.

storage.title: Storage and retention
storage.retentionHelp: A daily job deletes what is older than these limits, on every instance at most once a day.
storage.runsDaysHint: Older runs are deleted with their delivery attempts, shared links and files.
storage.artifactsDaysHint: Older files are deleted; the run stays, and its links answer that the file is gone.
storage.fixed: Security events are kept for 365 days, and notifications for 90 days after they are resolved.
storage.backupHelp: Backups are configured on the server with the ROWBIRD_BACKUP_* variables. You can also run rowbird backup at any time.
storage.backupPostgres: The internal store is Postgres: back it up with pg_dump. Scheduled backups only cover SQLite.
storage.backupOff: Scheduled backups are off. Set ROWBIRD_BACKUP_SCHEDULE (a cron expression in UTC) to turn them on.

destinations.s3: Backup directory and S3 bucket, keeping the latest {keep}

storage.masterKeyReminder: Backups do not include the master key. Keep a copy of it somewhere safe: without it, the saved credentials in a backup cannot be read.

about.title: About
about.updatesHelp: Once a day Rowbird can ask GitHub for the latest release. The request carries only the running version; nothing about your data or your users is sent.
about.disabledByServer: The update check is turned off on the server (ROWBIRD_UPDATE_CHECK=false).
about.upToDate: You are on the latest release (checked {when}).

ai.not_configured: The AI assistant is not set up. An admin can choose a provider in Settings > AI.
ai.no_schema: The connection's schema has not been read yet. Refresh it on the connection page first.
ai.too_many_requests: Too many assistant requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
ai.auth_failed: The AI provider refused the API key. Check it in Settings > AI.
ai.rejected: The AI provider refused the request.
ai.unreachable: The AI provider could not be reached.
ai.rate_limited: The AI provider is limiting requests. Try again later.
ai.timeout: The AI provider took too long to answer.
ai.network_blocked: The AI provider's address is blocked by the network policy.
ai.failed: The AI provider failed to answer.
ai.invalid_output: The AI answer could not be used. Try rephrasing the request.

auth.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again.
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
auth.csrf_failed: The request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth.challenge_expired: The sign-in attempt expired. Enter your email and password again.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth.mfa_setup_required: Set up two-factor authentication before continuing.
auth.oidc_unavailable: Single sign-on is not set up on this server.
auth.oidc_failed: Single sign-on did not complete. Try again.
auth.oidc_no_account: There is no Rowbird account for this identity. Ask an admin to add you.
auth.oidc_domain_not_allowed: Your email domain is not allowed to sign in here.
auth.oidc_email_unverified: Your identity provider has not verified your email, so it cannot be used here.
auth.oidc_discovery_failed: The identity provider could not be reached at this address.
auth.reset_invalid: This link is invalid, was already used or has expired. Ask for a new one.

channel.name_taken: A channel with this name already exists
channel.in_use: The channel is used by reports and cannot be deleted

condition.column_not_found: The condition refers to a column the query does not return.
condition.invalid_value: The condition's value does not fit the column's type.

conflict.version: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload and try again.
conflict.duplicate: This value is already in use.

connection.name_taken: A connection with this name already exists.
connection.in_use: The connection is used by queries and cannot be deleted.
connection.auth_failed: The database rejected the user or password.
connection.host_unreachable: The database server could not be reached. Check the host, the port and the firewall.
connection.tls_required: The database server requires an encrypted (TLS) connection. Change the TLS mode.
connection.tls_failed: The encrypted (TLS) connection could not be established. Check the TLS mode and certificates.
connection.database_not_found: The database was not found, or the user cannot access it.
connection.timeout: The database server did not answer in time.
connection.network_blocked: The network policy of this Rowbird does not allow this address.
connection.path_not_allowed: The file is outside the directories allowed for SQLite (ROWBIRD_SQLITE_DIRS).
connection.ssh_auth_failed: The SSH host rejected the user, password or key.
connection.ssh_host_key_unknown: The SSH host key must be confirmed.
connection.ssh_host_key_mismatch: The SSH host key changed since it was confirmed. If the change is expected, update the fingerprint.
connection.ssh_unreachable: The SSH host could not be reached.

delivery.no_system_mailer: No email channel is marked for system mail. Mark one in Channels to send tests by email.
delivery.not_failed: Only a failed delivery can be sent again.
delivery.not_resendable: This delivery cannot be sent again: it was a test to you, or its delivery was deleted.
delivery.auth_failed: The destination refused the credentials. Check the channel settings.
delivery.unreachable: The destination could not be reached.
delivery.too_large: The message was too large for the destination.
delivery.rate_limited: The destination is limiting requests. Try again later.
delivery.timeout: The destination took too long to answer.
delivery.network_blocked: The address is blocked by the network policy (private addresses are not allowed).
delivery.base_url_missing: Links need ROWBIRD_BASE_URL, which is not set.
delivery.channel_unavailable: The channel no longer exists or cannot be used.
delivery.result_unavailable: The result is no longer available to build the files.

gitops.not_managed: This is not managed by the configuration directory.
gitops.not_detached: This was not detached from the configuration directory.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

link.not_found: This link does not exist. Check that it was copied completely.
link.expired: This link has expired or was revoked. Ask whoever shared it for a new one.
link.login_required: Sign in to open this link.

query.slug_taken: A query with this slug already exists.
query.in_use: The query is used by reports and cannot be deleted.
query.timeout: The query took longer than the time limit.
query.multiple_statements: Only one statement is allowed. The connection does not allow several.
query.read_only: The query tried to change data. Rowbird only reads.
query.failed: The database could not run the query. Check the SQL.

report.slug_taken: A report with this slug already exists.
report.run_active: The report has a run in progress. Wait for it or cancel it first.

request.unsupported_media_type: The request format is not supported.
request.method_not_allowed: This action is not allowed here.

resource.not_found: It was not found. It may have been removed.
resource.managed_by_gitops: This is managed by the configuration directory. An admin can detach it to change it here.

route.not_found: There is no such API endpoint.

run.instance_lost: The server running it stopped unexpectedly.
run.overlap: Skipped: the previous run was still in progress.
run.condition_false: Skipped: the condition did not hold.
run.invalid_params: The query's parameters are missing or invalid.
run.query_missing: The report's query no longer exists.
run.internal: An unexpected error happened while running the report.
run.result_unavailable: The result of this run is no longer available.
run.delivery_failed: The query ran, but some deliveries failed. You can send them again.

setup.completed: Rowbird is already set up. Sign in instead.

user.last_admin: The workspace needs at least one active admin.
user.self_modification: You cannot change your own role or disable your own account.
user.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.

validation.email: Enter valid email addresses, separated by commas.
validation.too_short: Too short. Use at least 10 characters.
validation.password_common: This password is too common or too easy to guess.
validation.code_invalid: The code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try the current code.
validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers, dashes and underscores, starting with a letter or number.
validation.param_undefined: This parameter is used in the SQL but not defined.
validation.param_name: Use letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
validation.param_reserved: This name is reserved for a built-in parameter.
validation.cron: Enter a valid cron expression with five fields, at most once a minute.
validation.cron_never: This schedule never runs; check the day and month.
validation.base_url_missing: Set ROWBIRD_BASE_URL to share files as links.
validation.template: The template has a syntax error.
validation.template_variable: The template uses a variable that does not exist.
validation.url: Enter an http or https address.
validation.no_delivery: This report has no delivery on that channel.
validation.same_channel: Choose a different channel from the primary.

passkey.unavailable: Passkeys need the public URL of this server (ROWBIRD_BASE_URL).
passkey.failed: The passkey could not be verified. Try again, or use another passkey.

connections.help: Databases Rowbird reads from. Rowbird never writes to them.
connections.askAdmin: Ask an admin to add a connection.
connections.emptyBody: A connection tells Rowbird how to reach one of your databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server or SQLite. Queries and reports run on connections.
connections.chooseDriverHelp: You can add more connections later.
connections.name: Name
connections.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Used to refer to this connection in YAML files.
connections.deleteImpact: The connection {name} and its stored credentials will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
connections.savedWithError: Connection saved, but the check failed: {error}

limits.title: Limits
limits.help: Protect the database from long or large queries.
limits.multi: Allow several statements in one query
limits.multiWarning: Several statements in one query make it possible to change data if the database user can write. Use a read-only user.

test.okDetail: {version}, answered in {ms} ms, {tables} tables and views found.

writeWarning.title: This user can change data
writeWarning.body: Rowbird only reads, but a user with write permission is riskier. Create a database user with read-only permissions and use it here.

fingerprint.title: Confirm the SSH host key
fingerprint.body: This is the first connection to this SSH host. Compare the fingerprint below with the one shown by ssh-keygen -lf on the host before trusting it.
fingerprint.trust: Trust this key and test again

schema.title: Schema
schema.aiHelp: Tables excluded from the AI assistant are never sent to it.
schema.emptyBody: Test the connection or read the schema again. Only tables the user can read are listed.

params.title: Parameters
params.none: No parameters. Write a name between double braces in the SQL, such as today, to add one.
params.name: Name

results.title: Results
results.hint: Run the query (Ctrl or Cmd + Enter) to see a preview of up to 100 rows.
results.truncated: Showing the first {rows} rows; there are more.

queries.help: SQL saved with its history. Reports run queries on a schedule.
queries.emptyBody: A query is SQL that runs on a connection, with parameters such as today or yesterday. Every save keeps a version you can compare and restore.
queries.usedBy: used by one report | used by {n} reports

editor.title: Title
editor.slugHint: Used to refer to this query in YAML files.
editor.needConnection: Add a connection first, so queries have a database to run on.
editor.noSchema: No tables yet. Test the connection to read its schema.
editor.toggleColumns: Show or hide the columns of {table}
editor.saveHelp: Changing the SQL or the parameters creates a new version.
editor.saveFirstHelp: The first version of the query is saved.
editor.saveImpact: This query is used by one report; it will run the new version. | This query is used by {n} reports; they will run the new version.
editor.noteHint: Optional. What changed, shown in the history.
editor.deleteImpact: The query {title} and its {n} versions will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

versions.title: Versions
versions.help: Every change to the SQL or parameters is kept. Pick a version to compare it with the current one.
versions.label: Version {n}
versions.pick: Pick an older version to compare.
versions.comparing: Changes from version {n} to the current version {current}.
versions.restoreImpact: A new version is created with the SQL and parameters of version {n}. The history is kept.

reports.help: Queries that run on a schedule and deliver their results when the condition holds.
reports.emptyBody: A report runs a saved query on a schedule, checks a condition and delivers the result. Create one to have your SQL results arrive on their own.

fields.title: Title
fields.overlap: When the previous run is still going
fields.notifyOwner: Notify the owner when a run fails

editor.needQuery: Save a query first; a report runs a saved query.
editor.slugHint: Used to refer to this report in YAML files.
editor.overridesHelp: Values for the query's parameters when this report runs. Leave a field empty to use the default.
editor.noDefault: No default; a value is required.
editor.maxRowsHint: Leave empty to use the connection's limit.
editor.retryBackoffHint: Each further retry waits twice as long.
editor.misfireHint: For example, when the server was down at the scheduled time. Missed runs are never all queued.
editor.overlapHint: Only for scheduled runs; manual runs always start.

detail.runDeliverHint: A full run: it counts toward failures and the result-changed condition.
detail.autoPaused: Paused after {n} consecutive failed runs. Fix the cause and resume the report.
detail.allRuns: See all runs of this report
detail.deleteImpact: {title} and its run history will be deleted. Its query is kept.

chart.alt: The latest {n} runs: {rate}% succeeded, median duration {median}.

schedule.dayOfMonthHint: Months without this day are skipped.
schedule.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week.

conditions.help: Deliver only when the result matches. Without rules, every run delivers.

runs.help: Every execution of every report, newest first.
runs.emptyBody: Runs appear here when a report runs on its schedule or when someone runs it by hand.

filters.emptyBody: Try another status, report, trigger or period, or clear the filters to see every run.

detail.conditionPassed: Holds; the result goes on to delivery.
detail.conditionFailed: Does not hold; nothing is delivered.
detail.notDelivered: Not delivered: this run only shows the result.
detail.downloadUntil: Available until {time}. The file uses your language and the report's time zone.
detail.downloadExpired: The result of this run can no longer be downloaded.
detail.fallbackToLink: Files too large to attach were sent as links.
detail.filesUntil: The delivered files can be downloaded until {time}.

channels.help: Where reports are delivered: email, chat, webhooks, storage and monitors.
channels.emptyBody: A channel is a destination with its credentials, such as an SMTP server or a Slack workspace. Reports deliver to channels.
channels.askAdmin: Ask an admin to add a channel.
channels.unused: No report delivers to this channel yet.
channels.systemMailerHelp: Sends password resets and "send test to me". Only one email channel can do this.
channels.name: Name
channels.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Used to reference the channel in YAML.
channels.chooseTypeHelp: You can test the settings before saving.
channels.retryFailed: Resend failed deliveries of the last 24 hours
channels.retryQueued: No deliveries queued | 1 delivery is being sent again | {n} deliveries are being sent again
channels.retryNothing: There are no failed deliveries to send again.
channels.deleteImpact: Delete the channel {name}? Its settings and credentials are removed.
channels.deleteInUse: This channel is used by 1 report. Remove its delivery first. | This channel is used by {n} reports. Remove their deliveries first.

test.okDetail: The destination accepted the test message.

channels.tlsHint465: Port 465 usually expects TLS from the start: choose "tls", or use port 587 with STARTTLS. Otherwise the test waits for the timeout.
channels.tlsHint587: Port 587 usually expects STARTTLS: choose "starttls", or use port 465 with TLS. Otherwise the test waits for the timeout.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.help: Where each run goes, and in which form.
deliveries.editorHelp: Choose the channel, what to send and how. The preview uses the latest result of the report.
deliveries.emptyBody: Add a delivery to send each run to a channel: the rows in the message, files attached, or links to download them.

modeHelp.inline: The first rows appear in the message itself.
modeHelp.attachment: Files are attached; files too large for the destination are sent as links.
modeHelp.link: The message carries links that download the files until they expire.

deliveries.linksDisabled: Links need ROWBIRD_BASE_URL, the public address of this server. Set it to send links; large attachments also need it.
deliveries.inlineWithFiles: Also show the first rows in the message
deliveries.linkFallbackHint: Used when a file is too large to attach.
deliveries.testChannel: Send a test to this channel
deliveries.testQueued: Running the report; the result goes to {email}.
deliveries.testQueuedChannel: Running the report; the result goes to this channel only.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.help: With the latest result of the report. Nothing is sent.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.title: Message preview

links.help: Download links sent by deliveries. Revoke one to stop it at once.
links.emptyBody: Links appear here when a delivery sends files as links, or when a file is too large to attach.
links.revokeImpact: Anyone with the link to {file} will no longer be able to download it. This cannot be undone.

detail.title: Shared link
detail.help: What was shared, who can open it, and the latest downloads.
detail.noDownloadsBody: Each download through this link shows up here with its time, the signed-in user when there is one, and where it came from.
detail.latestOnly: Only the latest 100 downloads are listed.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.help: Channels and reports that need attention. Repeated failures are counted on one notification until the problem ends.

types.report_paused: Report {report} was paused after {failures} failures in a row
types.gitops_failed: The configuration directory was not applied
types.report_orphaned: Report {report} left the configuration directory and was paused

home.help: What runs next, what failed recently and how deliveries are doing.

successRate.help: Scheduled runs and manual runs that deliver. Partial runs count as not successful; skipped runs are left out.

nextRuns.title: Next runs

onboarding.title: Get your first report delivered
onboarding.help: {done} of {total} steps done. Each one takes a minute.

connection.title: Connect a database
connection.help: Rowbird reads from it, never writes.

query.title: Write a query
query.help: The SQL whose result you want to receive.

report.help: When to run the query and where to send the result.

delivery.title: Receive the first delivery
delivery.help: Wait for the schedule, or use "Run now" or "Send test to me" on the report.

panel.title: Assistant
panel.help: Describe the query you need. The proposal shows as a change to the current SQL; nothing runs until you apply it and run the preview.
panel.off: The AI assistant is not set up in this workspace.
panel.setUp: Set it up in Settings > AI
panel.askAdmin: Ask an admin to choose a provider in Settings > AI.
panel.placeholder: For example: total sales per region this month, largest first
panel.privacy: The request and the schema are sent to the AI provider; rows are never sent.
panel.name: Suggested name
panel.applyNote: Applying replaces the SQL in the editor. Review it and run the preview before saving.
panel.applied: Proposal applied. Review it and run the preview.

schedule.label: Describe when to run
schedule.placeholder: For example: every weekday at 8 in the morning

warnings.not_read_only: This SQL may change data. Queries run in read-only transactions, but review it carefully.
warnings.multiple_statements: This SQL has more than one statement; connections run one unless they allow more.
warnings.schedule_invalid: The suggested schedule was not valid and was left out.
warnings.schema_truncated: The schema is large, so only part of it was sent. Mention the tables you need by name.
warnings.no_schedule: The description could not be turned into a schedule.

config.title: Import / export
config.help: Reports, queries, connections and channels as YAML: to copy them to another instance, keep them in Git, or share them. Secrets are never exported.

export.titleSome: Export {n} report | Export {n} report | Export {n} reports
export.help: Each report goes with its query.
export.withChannels: Include the channels they deliver to
export.secrets: Passwords and tokens are not exported: the file names an environment variable for each, which the import asks for.

import.missingHelp: The documents use connections or channels that do not exist here. Pick existing ones to use instead.
import.secretsHelp: Values for the secrets the documents ask for. They are stored encrypted with the resource.
import.secretOptional: Leave empty to keep the current value ({env}).
import.summary: {create} to create, {update} to update, {unchanged} unchanged, {skip} skipped, {conflict} to decide.
import.blocked: Resolve the items above to apply.
import.done: Everything was applied in one go.

managed.title: Managed by the configuration directory
managed.body: This comes from the GitOps directory and is applied again when the server starts, so it is read only here.
managed.detachImpact: Detach it from the configuration directory? You can then change it here, and the directory stops changing it until an admin gives it back.
managed.detached: Detached: you can change it here.
managed.attached: Given back to the configuration directory; it applies at the next start.
managed.detachedBody: Detached from the configuration directory: changes made here are kept.
managed.orphan: This report left the configuration directory, so it was paused. Put its document back to resume it, or delete it.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.help: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. A passkey also counts as two-factor authentication.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys are not available: the server needs its public URL (ROWBIRD_BASE_URL), and the browser must support them.
passkeys.addHelp: Your browser will ask where to save it: this device, your phone or a security key.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: Something to recognize it by, like "Work laptop".
passkeys.removeHelp: You will no longer be able to sign in with it. If it is your only second factor and your workspace requires one, you will be asked to set one up again.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.help: Type to find a page, an action, or a report, query, connection or channel.
palette.placeholder: Find a page, report, query, connection or channel…

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.help: Enter the email of your account and we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If {email} has an account here, a link to reset its password is on its way. It works once, within 30 minutes. Check your spam folder too.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.help: Pick a new password for your account. You will be signed out of every device.
resetPassword.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with it now.
